scientific_integrity: All numerical enumerations arise from independently executable supplied programs, not unverified extrapolation; the infinite-order conclusions have a mathematical proof. Authorship, external validation and publication priority are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The symbolic proof concerns ordinary geodetic vertex sets in triangular graphs L(K_n), n>=3, and token jumping/sliding at minimum size; it does not evaluate odd-order reconfiguration diameters. Executable finite checks verify stated small-n ranges only. Incomplete indexing and potential inaccessible older research leave historical priority uncertain. The listed first_public_date is a day-verified 2001 online publication; 2000 source metadata supplies a year but no verified calendar day.
title: Geodetic bases of triangular graphs: parity, exact counts, and slide mobility
